title: Expected maximum depth bound
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers. For each $i\in\{1,\ldots,m\}$, let the depth be a natural-number-valued function of a subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a sign assignment on the coordinates outside $J$. Suppose $0\leq\delta\leq1$, and suppose that for every $i$, the expected value of $2^{\mathrm{depth}_i}$ under the random restriction with parameter $\delta$ is at most $2$. Then the expected maximum of these depths under the same random restriction is at most $\lceil\log_2(m+1)\rceil+2$.
